title: W3Schools: Merge Dictionaries (Override)
description: Given two dictionaries `d1` and `d2`, merge them into a single dictionary. If a key exists in both, the value in `d2` overrides `d1`.
constraints:
0 <= len(d1), len(d2) <= 10^4
• Time: O(N + M) | Space: O(N + M)
starter_code:
def merge_dicts(d1: dict, d2: dict) -> dict:
    pass
solution:
def merge_dicts(d1: dict, d2: dict) -> dict:
    res = dict(d1)
    res.update(d2)
    return res
explanation: Dictionary union / update merges pairs with d2 override in O(N + M) time.
